title: Model magic item curses, oaths and behavioral restrictions (M7)
description: Implement family M7 from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4: 12 rows — armor-of-vulnerability, berserker-axe, demon-armor, shield-of-missile-attraction, oathbow (exclusive sworn-enemy state: one at a time, until death or 7th dawn), sword-of-wounding (stacking wound counters 1d4/wound + healing suppression: hp lost regainable only via rest — F6/F7 hooks), ring-of-mind-shielding (soul capture), orb-of-dragonkind (enslavement), robe-of-the-archmagi (alignment attunement gate), talisman-of-pure-good/ultimate-evil (alignment interaction), deck-of-many-things persistent card states (Euryale/Donjon/Void). Source semantics to preserve: reveal-only-on-identify-or-attune, removal-fails-to-end-curse, remove-curse-or-similar as the ending. Interacts with the attunement state machine (Phase 1 F5) — curses constrain unattunement. Recommended agent: Opus 4.8.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Curse/oath/restriction clauses should distinguish source-derived pack semantics from live cursed/attuned/soul/card state and model-adjudicated behavioral rulings. Removal constraints and attunement interactions should bind to F5/F6/F7 or model-adjudicated-supported dispositions as evidence requires.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
